stem:
Arnav writes 37.0 °C and 98.6 °F for body temperature.

Which statement is correct?

options.text: 37.0 °C and 98.6 °F name the same temperature on two scales.
98.6 °F is hotter than 37.0 °C because 98.6 is a larger number.
Only the Celsius reading is a real temperature.

teacher.key_rationale: The two readings name one temperature on two scales. A larger number is not a hotter scale.
